title: Fourteen days notice, non-compliant re-route, exact band boundary
narrative: Cancelled two weeks ahead. The replacement flight got me in more than five hours later than I was meant to arrive.

documents.content:
BOOKING ZR7781 — Passenger: L. HADDAD (adult)
Carrier: Zephyr Regional (ZR)
ZR260  DUB 01 Oct 2026 16:45  ->  MXP 01 Oct 2026 20:15
Great-circle distance DUB-MXP: 1,200 km exactly (per carrier tariff table).
Status: CONFIRMED.

From: schedules@zephyr-regional.example
Sent: 17 Sep 2026 08:00 UTC
Subject: ZR260 01 Oct cancelled

ZR260 on 01 October is cancelled. We can re-route you on ZR266, departing DUB 01 Oct 18:20 and arriving MXP 01 Oct 01:35 on 02 October.
BOARDING PASS ZR266 01OCT2026 — HADDAD/L — seat 14F — travelled as re-routed

ZEPHYR REGIONAL OPS LOG — ZR260 / 01OCT2026
Status: CANCELLED
Cause code: FLT-IT
Cause text: Crew rostering system failure, ZR internal. Roster could not be published for 01 Oct DUB rotations.

derivation: S3.2(c) carrier's own IT/scheduling failure -> carrier-controlled
S4.1 notice 17 Sep 08:00 -> 01 Oct 16:45 is 14 days, inside the 7-20 day band -> 50%
S4.3 re-route arrived 01:35 on 02 Oct against an original 20:15 on 01 Oct, 5h 20m late, over the 4h limit -> exemption does not apply
S5.1 and S5.3 distance is exactly 1,200 km, and at exactly 1,200 km the lower band applies -> band A -> 180 units
